description: Go modules without semver module tags whose advisory fixes may be matched to release tags by commit date. A module selected at an untagged v0.0.0 pseudo-version and not listed here fails closed when an advisory fix is not a published module version. Read by pipelines/go/remediate.yaml (through scripts/build_candidate.sh) and scripts/evaluate_scan_gate.sh.

istio.io/istio.reason: Istio release tags omit the v prefix (1.12.8), so the module proxy has no semver versions and dependents select v0.0.0 pseudo-versions.
